That's the hypothesis-testing ternary: reasoning states uncertainty about git behavior, action tests it, observation resolves it. Event 0023/0025.

That's: failure observation triggers root-cause reasoning and revised corrective action.

The reasoning only restates the task description with no commitment to a next step.

candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explains the causal reason for a failure, error, or anomalous result reported in observations, identifying the mechanism that produced the unwanted outcome.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text assigning a cause to the observed failure or anomaly.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to an observed failure, error message, or anomalous result.
The reasoning states a specific cause or explanatory mechanism for that failure rather than merely noting that it happened.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates the error text without explaining its cause.
The reasoning discusses a failure only as a hypothetical possibility that has not been observed.

candidate_predicates.name: ASSESSES_ROBUSTNESS_ACROSS_HYPOTHETICAL_SCENARIOS
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning enumerates multiple hypothetical behaviors of an external actor or environment and selects the configuration or state that remains correct under every enumerated hypothesis.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text enumerating alternative hypothetical scenarios and comparing the validity of candidate states across them.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning describes at least two distinct hypothetical scenarios or procedures that an external actor might follow.
The reasoning evaluates which candidate state or action stays valid across those scenarios and favors the option that survives the most or all of them.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning considers only a single expected scenario.
The reasoning lists scenarios without drawing any comparative conclusion about which state to adopt.

candidate_predicates.name: ACKNOWLEDGES_RECURRING_OWN_ERROR
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning recognizes that the agent itself has repeatedly made the same mistake and imposes a corrective self-instruction to avoid it in the next action.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text noting the repeated nature of its own mistake and stating the corrective rule it will follow.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a mistake attributable to the agent's own prior actions.
The reasoning explicitly notes that the mistake has recurred or is a recurring pattern.
The reasoning states a concrete corrective commitment for the upcoming action.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes a first-time mistake without indicating recurrence.
The reasoning attributes the failure to the environment or external actor rather than to its own recurring behavior.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning draws a conclusion using identifiable information from a prior observation as supporting evidence.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning expressing the evidence-based conclusion.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying evidence for that conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a conclusion supported by identifiable content from the observation.
The observation contributes evidential support to the stated conclusion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without drawing a conclusion.
The observation is unrelated to the conclusion or provides no identifiable support.

candidate_predicates.name: PREDICTS_OBSERVED_OUTCOME
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning states in advance a specific expected observable result of a forthcoming action, and the observation reports exactly that expected result.

parameters.name: prediction_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the expected observable result before it is obtained.

parameters.name: confirming_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result that matches the stated expectation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning formulates a concrete expectation about a future observation, not merely a general hope.
The observation contains the specific result anticipated by the reasoning.
The temporal order is reasoning first, observation afterwards.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning is produced after the observation and only interprets it.
The observation differs from or does not address the expectation stated in the reasoning.
The expectation is too vague to be matched against the observation.

candidate_predicates.name: ADDRESSES_ERROR_WITH_CORRECTED_RETRY
candidate_predicates.definition: An action re-executes a previously failed operation after modifying the specific element that the error observation identified as the cause of failure.

parameters.name: error_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the earlier attempt failed and indicating the defective element.

parameters.name: retry_action
parameters.description: The action repeating the operation with the identified defect corrected.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a failure or validation error of a prior attempt at the same operation.
The retry action performs the same operation while supplying or changing the element named in the error.
The error observation precedes the retry action.
exclusion_conditions: The retry action repeats the operation unchanged, or changes an element unrelated to the reported error.
The prior attempt did not fail, or the retry targets a different operation.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_ASSUMPTION_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted action tests an uncertainty about system behavior identified in reasoning, and the resulting observation provides interpretable evidence that resolves that uncertainty.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performing the targeted test of the uncertain behavior.

parameters.name: assumption_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the specific uncertainty or assumption being tested.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the behavior relevant to the tested uncertainty.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific uncertainty or assumption about how something behaves.
The action is designed to elicit that behavior in isolation.
The observation reports a result interpretable as supporting or refuting the assumption.
exclusion_conditions: No identifiable uncertainty motivates the action.
The action exercises the whole system rather than isolating the questioned behavior.
The observation does not address the assumption being tested.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_REQUIREMENT_WITH_END_TO_END_EXECUTION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning states the acceptance outcomes expected from the delivered system, a single execution exercises the complete user-facing flow, and the observation reports each expected outcome together with completion evidence.

parameters.name: acceptance_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the end-to-end flow to be exercised and the outcomes each step must produce.

parameters.name: execution_action
parameters.description: The action running the complete end-to-end flow in one execution.

parameters.name: outcome_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the produced outputs for every step of the flow.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies the full sequence of user-facing steps and the output each step must yield.
The execution action exercises the whole sequence rather than an isolated component.
The observation reports the produced output for each expected outcome, allowing direct comparison with the stated expectations.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning states only a general goal without checkable expected outcomes.
The execution covers only a fragment of the user-facing flow.
The observation omits the outputs required for the comparison.

candidate_predicates.name: SELECTS_ACTION_FORM_TO_SATISFY_CONSTRAINT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning invokes an operating constraint that forbids a direct form of action and selects an alternative compliant form, and the action implements that compliant form.

parameters.name: constraint_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning citing the constraint and choosing the compliant alternative form of action.

parameters.name: compliant_action
parameters.description: The action carried out in the alternative form permitted by the constraint.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names a rule or constraint that restricts how the operation may be performed.
The reasoning selects a different form of action because of that restriction.
The action instantiates the selected compliant form.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning selects an action form for efficiency or convenience without citing a restricting rule.
The action does not correspond to the form chosen in the reasoning.

candidate_predicates.name: RESTORES_PRISTINE_STATE_FOR_EXTERNAL_EVALUATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning decides to return the system to its initial empty state because an external evaluator is expected to build that state itself, an action deletes the accumulated artifacts, and an observation confirms the state is empty.

parameters.name: reset_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning deciding which residual state must be removed because the evaluator will create its own.

parameters.name: reset_action
parameters.description: The action removing the accumulated refs, files, or objects.

parameters.name: reset_observation
parameters.description: The observation confirming that no residual artifacts remain.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning argues that leftover state created during testing could conflict with the evaluator's own setup steps.
The action removes the artifacts produced by the agent's own verification activity.
The observation shows that the corresponding state is now empty.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning removes state for tidiness without reference to a future external evaluation.
The observation shows residual artifacts still present.
The deleted state is part of the required deliverable rather than test residue.
